74.purpose: HUD precomposed Ö, hour byte 119 (NATTBÖN; also drawn by j.a in the save/load label). Row 0 = the diaeresis of cell 16 (palette 37+1 at cols 1-2 and 5-6, as drawn over Ä/Ö in messages), row 1 = gap, rows 2-7 = O (cell 34) rows 1,2,3,5,6,7: pixel-identical to the O body of the shipped HUD Ó (cell 68).

80.purpose: Ring overlay for Å/å (char code 125), drawn by the patched j.a at (x, y-2) after a normal A. Rows 0-2 = screen rows y-2..y: a 4x3 ring centred on the A apex (cols 2-5) that sits on the apex. Accent palette only: 1 on the top and right, 6 on the left and bottom (lit from the top right like the O body).
